methods.name_match: Unicode NFKD, case-fold, remove combining marks; compare each assigned geoBoundaries shapeName with current name.
methods.scope_partition: Filter pinned issue #496 global member IDs by current published Peru-area ancestry and compare against #497 IDs and all 204 area descendants.
methods.spatial_check: Projected-area mass comparison only for three parent ADM2 units and current ecological pieces. Geometry generalization and overlay topology errors prevent exact coverage conclusions.
methods.limitations: No coordinate edits; no exhaustive settlement gazetteer or authoritative identity for every multipart component was located. No inference of sovereignty or historical attributes.
